headline: BIL Vyapar Limited: Committee of Creditors meeting intimation in CIRP
sum: BIL Vyapar Limited has intimated the stock exchange of a Committee of Creditors meeting under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP). The company is progressing through formal insolvency resolution proceedings under the Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code.
detail: BIL Vyapar Limited, a retail/trading entity, has filed for Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process and notified the stock exchange (NSE) of a scheduled Committee of Creditors meeting. This is a mandatory disclosure under the Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code, 2016 and SEBI / stock exchange listing regulations. The CoC meeting is where creditors review the insolvency professional's disclosures, admit/reject claims, and assess resolution plans. No resolution plan amount or timeline is stated in the public intimation; further filings or CoC minutes would confirm substantive progress.
